description:
Verify a company against its official register, for onboarding or before paying or signing: an outcome with reasons, checks, warning signals and a proof code you can show an auditor. A registry check, not full KYB.
Use it to decide about a company. Don't use it for a cheap single read (lookup_company) or with a name (call search_companies first).
Inputs: country FR or ES or GB; identifier as for lookup_company (441639465); optional id_scheme; optional reference (your case id).
Returns: outcome (verified, partial, unverified; open insolvency never verified) + reasons, checks, signals (present, none_found, not_covered), recent changes, provenance, proof code (FUE-…).
Limits: 5 units (1 if not found); keyless 20/day. Stored 24 months. France: insolvency from BODACC since 2008. Public contracts won since 2024 (DECP, weekly). Spain: BORME acts since 2 January 2009. UK: no officers or PSCs. No person's name in any answer.
Search words: KYB, KYC, verify supplier, vérifier une société, verificar empresa.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

detail.description: summary: a few key fields; standard (default): the record, long lists shortened; full: everything.
detail.title: Detail

identifier.description: Official ID: FR SIREN or SIRET; ES Registro Mercantil sheet from search_companies. GB: Companies House company number, e.g. 00445790. Never a name.
identifier.title: Identifier

reference.description: Optional: your own case id, stored with the result.
reference.title: Reference

name: verify_company
title: Verify a company (registry check)
